thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and timeouts from model-runtime (model-runner) in us-west-2. Pager triggered. https://status.redwood.internal/INC-2345

amanda: Paging oncall. seeing spike in 5xx from model-runner group – errors look like segfaults and OOMs. Totals: 5xx rate ~18% for the last 3 min.

raj: I'm on it. grabbing logs and core dumps from the nodes flagged by the gateway.

miguel: which models affected? any customer impact? that's high.

amanda: Initial trace: heavy traffic to gpt-small-quant and a few nvme nodes. Impacting hosted customers in us-west-2 and a subset of Dedicated pools. Support ticket #7421 pinged.

tanya: @amanda can we failover traffic to fallback model (gpt-small-1.1b) while debugging? need to reduce user-facing errors.

raj: yes, can route traffic via routing-policy 'fallback-on-error' — doing a canary shift now for 10% -> 50%. running:

```
$ admin-cli route update --policy fallback-on-error --model gpt-small-1.1b --region us-west-2 --percent 50
```

ops-bot: routing update accepted. active policy: fallback-on-error -> gpt-small-1.1b (50%) :gear: 

amanda: Good. Also increasing autoscale burst for model-runner group to absorb retries.

miguel: I'm seeing repeated `malloc` failure in logs before segfaults. attaching snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] model-runner[pid:4287]: malloc: cannot allocate memory size=1024000
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] model-runner[pid:4287]: terminated with signal SIGSEGV
```

raj: That matches core dumps. Looks like some nodes hit OOM then segfault during KV cache growth.

tanya: Mitigation options: 1) reduce KV cache size, 2) restart affected runner processes, 3) revert recent quantization patch if it's related.

amanda: any recent deploys? deploy-bot shows `model-runner:v2.14.3` rolled out 02:40 UTC.

raj: Confirmed. I'm rolling back v2.14.3 on the 3 offending instances now.

```
$ deploy rollback model-runner --version v2.14.2 --instances i-0a1b2c3d
```

incident-bot: rollback initiated by raj. ETA ~3m per instance.

miguel: In parallel I'm scaling affected pool to +20% capacity and disabling prefetch to reduce mem pressure.

amanda: Support: notifying top-10 affected customers about degraded responses and fallback model. Draft message ready — cc: @customer-success.

tanya: Also collect `pmap` and `gdb` backtraces for the cores before we rotate nodes.

raj: collected backtrace for pid 4287 and uploaded to /var/tmp/incident-2105009876/coredumps/trace-4287.txt

miguel: Observing that memory use rises linearly with request sequence length — KV cache growth unchecked on large seqs. Looking into cache eviction bug.

amanda: Can we enable eviction policy `lru-strict` as a hotfix?

raj: applying config change now:

```
$ confctl set model-runner.kv_cache.eviction lru-strict --region us-west-2
```

ops-bot: config applied to 12 nodes. :white_check_mark:

amanda: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in last 5m after rollback + routing-fallback + eviction. Still seeing occasional timeouts.

tanya: We've got reproducible steps: long sequences + concurrent batch + new allocation path -> leak. I'll open PR reverting the allocation change in v2.14.3.

raj: For now, rolling restart completed on 3 nodes. No new segfaults in the last 4 minutes on those nodes.

miguel: Recommend follow-up: kernel freepage tuning, add OOM kill thresholds, and run a memstress test against staging using large-prefix workloads.

amanda: Action items:
- raj: monitor and keep rollback until PR merged (assigned)
- tanya: PR to revert allocation change and unit tests (assigned)
- miguel: run stress tests + postmortem data collection (assigned)
- customer-success: send status update to affected customers (assigned)

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). Severity: Sev2. Next update in 30m or on major change.

amanda: Thanks team. If error rate creeps back up, escalate to oncall-sre. Closing handoff to eng-oncall for the next watch.

eng-oncall: acknowledged handoff. monitoring alert channels and will reopen if needed.
